messages:
marta: incident-bot paged me for high model-routing fallback rate in us-west (~00:12UTC). lots of 503s and subsequent slower 200s from fallback.
incident-bot: [ALERT] fallback-rate > 5% over 5m for service=runtime (pager: @marta).
marta: I’m looking now. initial read: router can't allocate slots for v2-quant so it falls back to v1. autoscaler didn’t react fast enough during the burst.
sam: are customers seeing failures or just slower responses?
priya: mix of both. some requests get 503 then retry to fallback; others timeout. logs show repeated "no free slot" in router: ```WARN router - no slot for model v2-quant, routing to fallback```
priya: snippet: `grep "no slot for model v2-quant" /var/log/router/2026-03-15.log | head`
marta: thanks. looks like transient capacity pressure after a large multi-tenant batch job hit us.
sam: we should reduce page noise while we stabilize. current alert is 3% over 3m and is firing on short spikes. propose bump to 6% over 5m and add clear runbook links so oncall knows triage steps.
marta: agree but annotate alert first so folks know when to ignore transient blips vs real impact. I’ll add an annotation and owner.
priya: created quick troubleshooting dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/fallback-rate-by-region?from=now-1h — shows spike concentrated in us-west and a smaller blip in eu-central.
deploy-bot: patch deployed: routing autoscaler cooldown set to 90s (change-id: cfg-7891). rollout succeeded in us-west, +3 nodes added.
sam: I’m updating monitoring now: squelch window 3m -> 5m; threshold 3% -> 6%; added a runbook link in the alert description.
priya: updated runbook page: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/fallback-mitigation with steps: check dashboard, grep router logs for "no slot", check autoscaler metrics, scale pool if impact > 1% customers. pasted steps:
```
- check router logs for "no slot" messages
- check autoscaler metric: scaler.metric.current_available
- temporarily scale up pool via console/terraform if customer impact > 1%
- annotate alert with findings and link to PD incident
```
marta: I annotated the alert with the runbook link and set owner to eng-oncall-sre.
priya: also added dashboard panels: "top 10 customers by fallback count" and a "recent errors" table to speed triage.
sam: I'll take a handoff at 00:30UTC. marta, if you’re good with the patch and the alert changes, get some rest.
marta: confirmed us-west 503s back near baseline. customer-facing error rate decreased after autoscaler nodes came up. leaving a short note in the runbook: "post-incident: review routing cooldown and consider canary for autoscaler config changes".
sam: can we add a follow-up: run a traffic replay to exercise warm-up and autoscaler behavior?
priya: yes, will create a ticket and assign to leo for a replay + validation job.
priya: assigning action items now:
- priya: update runbook and dashboards (done)
- sam: monitor for 24h and run retrospective
- leo: traffic replay test (assigned)
- marta: draft incident notes and link PD incident PD-99812
incident-bot: PD-99812 closed by sam.
sam: handoff complete, summary dropped into #oncall-handoffs. :white_check_mark:
notes: post-incident tuning: increased alert window to 5m, threshold to 6%, added runbook link, autoscaler cooldown adjusted, dashboard created. owners assigned for follow-up and traffic replay.
